title: Ninja creami maker
text: Ninja creami maker. If you own a Ninja creami maker, these are the pints you'll need to make and store your homemade frozen treats - unless you purchased your maker at a big box store - your maker comes with FOUR pints!  I didn't realize that until AFTER I had purchased these!  No worries.  I'll use them!  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Ninja XSKPNTLID2 CREAMi Pints and Lids
features: Use to store all your CREAMi creations like ice cream, gelato, sorbet, and more.
Includes: (4) 16oz. CREAMi Pints, (4) Storage Lids, Instruction Book
description: The Ninja CREAMi transforms frozen solid bases into ice cream, sorbets, milkshakes, and more at the touch of a button. Ninja’s Creamify technology enables the CREAMi to break down a uniformly frozen block into an incredibly smooth, creamy texture in minutes. From healthy to indulgent, the Ninja CREAMi can create frozen treats as unique as you are! Main unit sold separately.
